fallback_reply: Thanks for contacting Harbor Point Bank. I couldn't match your message to a topic I can help with yet. Could you rephrase it, or reach a support agent in the app under Help > Chat with us?

cards.title: Card delivery times
facts: New cards arrive within 5-7 business days after they ship.
Tracking appears in the app under Cards > Delivery.
If a card has not arrived after 10 business days, we send a free replacement.
cards.reply_template: Thanks for asking about your card. {facts} I hope it reaches you soon.

cards.title: Lost or stolen cards
facts: Freeze the card right away in the app under Cards > Freeze.
Report it as lost or stolen so the card is cancelled for good.
A replacement card ships for free within 5-7 business days.
cards.reply_template: I'm sorry to hear about your card. {facts} Charges made after you report the card are not your responsibility.

cards.title: Transfers the recipient has not received
facts: Transfers in the same currency arrive within 1 business day; international transfers can take up to 3.
Check that the recipient's account details match the ones in the transfer receipt.
If the money is still missing after 3 business days, we open a trace at no cost.
cards.reply_template: Thanks for letting us know the money hasn't arrived. {facts}

cards.title: Exchange rates
facts: We use the interbank rate on weekdays.
A 0.5% markup applies to currency exchanges on weekends.
The exact rate is shown in the app before you confirm any exchange.
cards.reply_template: Here is how our exchange rates work. {facts}

cards.title: Failed top-ups
facts: A failed top-up is never charged; any pending hold is released within 2 business days.
Top-ups usually fail because the card issuer declined them or the card details are out of date.
Try again with a different card or by bank transfer.
cards.reply_template: Sorry your top-up didn't go through. {facts}

cards.title: Pending transfers
facts: Most transfers leave pending status within 1 business day.
Transfers made after 5 pm or on weekends start processing the next business day.
Some transfers are held for a short security review, which can add up to 24 hours.
cards.reply_template: Thanks for your patience with this transfer. {facts}

cards.title: Card payment fees
facts: Card payments in your account's currency are free.
Payments in a foreign currency carry a 1% fee.
Some merchants add their own surcharge, which we cannot refund.
cards.reply_template: I understand an unexpected fee is frustrating. {facts} The fee breakdown is on each transaction in the app.

cards.title: Identity verification
facts: Verification needs a photo of a government-issued ID and a selfie.
Most checks finish within 10 minutes.
Some features stay locked until verification is complete.
cards.reply_template: Happy to help you get verified. {facts} You can start from Profile > Verify identity.

cards.title: Refunds that have not appeared
facts: Merchants can take up to 10 business days to send a refund.
A refund appears as a separate credit, not as a change to the original payment.
If it is missing after 15 business days, we can open a dispute with the merchant.
cards.reply_template: Sorry you're still waiting on your refund. {facts}

cards.title: Wrong amount of cash from an ATM
facts: Report the ATM, date, and amount in the app within 60 days.
We contact the ATM operator, which usually takes 5-10 business days.
Confirmed shortfalls are credited back to your account.
cards.reply_template: I'm sorry the ATM gave you the wrong amount. {facts}
